reading_rule: Consume each row as a premise or falsifier before proof search. A result implied by a row is dominated; use the stronger row and continue toward the parent theorem. Route choice remains unrestricted.

results.exact_statement: For Zudilin's normalized forms v_m^* at x = z = 1 and the Hankel determinant V_N^* = det(v_(i+j)^*), this corpus carries an all-rank source proof of the sharp q-order N(N-1)(2N-1)/6 together with the exact leading coefficient, assembled from exact source tails, associated reciprocals, the filtered source operator recurrence, the all-column first transformed row, the backward-shift determinant, the associated-graded order, and the factorial assembly. Roughly forty declarations are named, including det_zudilinBackwardShiftMatrix, det_zudilinBackwardShiftedMomentMatrix, order_det_eq_of_unique_minimizing_permutation, det_zudilinAssociatedLeadingMatrix, det_zudilinAssociatedLeadingMatrix_ne_zero, order_det_zudilinAssociatedLeadingMatrix_eq_sum_sq, six_mul_order_det_zudilinAssociatedLeadingMatrix and zudilinSharpHankelOrderAndCoeff_algebraicAssembly. Exactness is verified by exact computation for N <= 7.
results.hypotheses: All-rank source proof, partly formalised. The primary source proves only the inequality ord_q V_N^* >= N(N-1)(2N-1)/6; the exact leading coefficients, the associated-graded transformed-row coefficient, the Vandermonde leading matrix and the tail-index reciprocal-state identity are authored here.

results.why_it_matters: Turning a printed >= into an = with an exact leading coefficient, for a named construction in the q-series and Pade literature, is a short checkable theorem that a specialist can verify directly, and it is exactly the kind of result the corpus has been sitting on without stating.

results.exact_statement: For every cyclotomic index d, the normalized first d-by-d cross block at the first appearance of Phi_d is the wrapped Hankel matrix H_(i,j) = a_(i+j mod d) K^[i+j >= d], and its determinant is, up to the explicit permutation sign, Res(W(x), K x^d - 1). At a prime above 2, writing d = 2^a m with m odd and e = 2^(a-1), the exact coefficient valuations admit a supporting affine slope making the anti-diagonal the unique minimum, with normalized determinant valuation exactly 3aed; for odd d the corresponding minimum has valuation zero. Therefore the full cyclotomic first-appearance associated-graded residue is NONZERO for every d.
results.hypotheses: Authored all-d boundary-mode elimination with exact regression; proof and checker are ZudilinFirstBlockResultantProof.md and check_zudilin_first_block_resultant.py.
supersedes: the previously open cancellation among minimum-order first-appearance terms
results.why_it_matters: It is the all-d nonvanishing statement the exactness proof needs at the first appearance of each cyclotomic factor.

results.exact_statement: After extracting H_i H_j from the (i,j) Hankel entry, the residual Phi_d exponent for i,j >= d is exactly 1 or 4, so the primitive residual determinant contains prod_{1 <= d, 2d < N} Phi_d(p)^(N - 2d). The valuation bound is EXACT: reverse the first 2d indices and pair the remaining residue multiset antitonically to exhibit a permutation term of total Phi_d-order N - 2d. Hence no nested argument using only entrywise valuations can force more; only cancellation among minimum-order terms can. Exact rank four has p^30 Phi_1^2; at rank five the mu = 0 and mu = 1 specializations have gcd p^55 Phi_1^3 Phi_2.

results.exact_statement: Zudilin, On the irrationality of generalized q-logarithm, Research in Number Theory 2 (2016), Article 15, Section 4 (source TeX lines 278-380) defines V_n, v_n^*, D_l, proves the backward-shift order lemma, and derives ord_q V_N^* >= N(N-1)(2N-1)/6. That inequality, the normalized forms, the Hankel determinant and the backward-shift operator are the SOURCE's, not this corpus's. The antecedent is Zudilin 2016, not Zudilin 2004; the longitudinal record corrects that specifically.
